answer: An agent economy can require a tundra-expedition credential: first, an applicant locks a 400-token bond for 30 days; second, it completes five supervised deliveries, each checked by a different random auditor; third, the bond returns only after 20 clean days, while one proven fraud burns 200 tokens. A Sybil farm thus pays 400 tokens and 30 idle days per fake identity, so 100 clones cost 40,000 tokens before earning anything. Like carving a jade seal, real identity takes slow visible work, and an ivory stamp appearing overnight without that wear is easy to reject.
